product_name_specific: D8K - DTI 8 - EU VI Step E; D5K - DTI 5 - EU VI Step E
risk_description:
When the decrystallisation regeneration threshold is reached, the amount of urea injected by the AdBlue injection system is reduced by approx. 30 percent. 
As a result, the vehicle emission levels will temporarily exceed regulatory limits.
legal_provision: The product does not meet the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
